procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 43 was represented by Torvar Mirsky.
The technical committee was represented by Rob Taylor (chair of the technical committee) .
Hans Peter Voils (diver) gave evidence as a witness for GER 43. Procedural matters of the reopened hearing:
The original decision was given on 22.06.2026 at 20:45 and was published on the notice board at 20:56.
The international jury decided that they may have made a significant error, and reopen the hearing on 23.06.2026 in accordance with RRS 63.7(a)(2). The parties were not present.
facts: A diver is arranged to clean GER 43 during the event without underwater breathing apparatus.
At around 6:50am on 22.06.2026 a diver was cleaning the hull of GER 43 using breathing apparatus in the marina.
GER 43 was not present and not aware the usage of breathing apparatus.
The diver observed the boat was reasonably clean prior to cleaning.
The diver stated during the hearing the breathing apparatus did not add to the cleaning.
Facts found in the reopened hearing:
GER 43 sailed race 4 after the diver cleaning.
conclusions: By cleaning the hull using underwater breathing apparatus, GER 43 broke SI 19.2.
By cleaning the hull using underwater breathing apparatus, GER 43 did not compromise safety nor gain a competitive advantage.
By cleaning the hull using underwater breathing apparatus, GER 43 broke SI 19.2.
By cleaning the hull using underwater breathing apparatus, GER 43 may gain a competitive advantage but not certain advantage.
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 5% was decided.
There was no circumstances to justify increasing or decreasing.
The penalty given to GER 43 is, 5% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method describe in RRS 44.3(c ) and applied to race 4, but not worse than the score for DNF.
Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 20% was decided.
The penalty is increased because the breach was not accidental.
The penalty given to GER 43 is, 30% discretionary penalty, calculated using the method described in RRS 44.3(c ) and applied to race 4.
